title: Oily Smoky Jamaican Chicken Wings Skewers
description: Charred and silky Jamaican chicken wings skewers, grilled to perfection with a light and smoky flavor, featuring chicken wings and a blend of spices, kosher-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread 2-3 chicken wings onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each wing.
Grill the skewers for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
While the chicken is grilling, chop the scotch bonnet peppers and add to the marinade bowl.
After the chicken has grilled for 15 minutes, brush the skewers with the marinade and continue grilling.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken wings skewers hot, garnished with chopped scotch bonnet peppers and a side of additional marinade for dipping.
